validation.evidence: M133/mode_1 has a SINGLE SpinType (ST=13) across all 40,000 rounds (8 robots x 5000). ST=13 is the cost-bearing base reel spin paying via PayoutIdToWinAmount with an IN-LINE wild-lock respin feature carried on the same ST (ReMarks-discriminated), NOT a separate ST. SEQUENCE PROOF: ReMarks dist = {'' : 36626 (base spins), 'trigger' : 3374 (lock respins)}; the 'trigger' records carry a non-empty LockLines token (e.g. '1-','2-','3-','1-2-') recording which reel column(s) landed a full-wild column ('wild-wild-wild-'/'wild2x-wild2x-wild2x-') and locked; respin chains are bounded (chain-length dist {1:3028, 2:173}, max 2 locked columns) and every chain is preceded AND followed by a '' base spin (preceding ReMarks {'' :3200}, following {'' :3198}). PLAY-NAME SOURCE (server, not invented): per-robot analysisResult taxonomy declares base TotalWin SpinType='Normal' and FeatureWin='LockReSpin' (the in-line lock-respin feature); server FeatureWin LockReSpin total = 34,483,000 = full machine win. ECONOMY: CostCredits=0 on ALL records (a per-record echo, NOT the real cost); the true per-spin economy is captured by the identity LastCredits = 1e14 - 1000(bet) + WinCredits, which holds for ALL 40,000 records (implied per-record cost = 1000 for both '' and 'trigger'); win field = WinCredits. CONSERVATION (exact): for all 7728 winning rounds sum(PayoutIdToWinAmount values) == WinCredits with zero exceptions; global sum(WinCredits) == sum(payid) == 34,483,000. COLLECT AUDIT: 0 rounds with Win>0 AND payid present AND sum(payid)<Win (no additive non-payid residual). 3-LAYER REUSE AUDIT: (a) ST=13 signature [BetAmount,CostCredits,StopSymbolsByCol,PayoutByPayline,PayoutIdToWinAmount,RewardLastNode,ReelSkin,WinCredits] matches the validated single-ST paid_spin/Normal base-spin shared by 59 registered precedents (M1/M14/M105/M135/...), with the lock-respin riding the LockLines mechanic family. (b) Shared parser core/parser.py (lines 1591-1595) populates lock_lines_spins/lock_lines_total_lines/lock_lines_win from M133's LockLines field, and the registered fleet plugin features/machine_mechanics.py consumes it parser-blind into a lock_lines section; per-ST reel/payid/outcome/RTP-bucket dims are covered by the shared PER_SPINTYPE plugins. NO new code, NO fork. The M104-exclusive lock_respin_dynamics plugin is correctly NOT the target (it is LockSymbols-only and play-gated to 'LockSymbolSpin'; M133 has LockSymbols absent -> lock_symbols.applicable=False). (c) Ran the shared parser on M133's real chunk: lock_lines_spins=3374 (== independently derived 'trigger' count), lock_lines_total_lines=3650, lock_lines_win=11,263,000, lock_symbols_spins=0; drove machine_mechanics.emit -> lock_lines{applicable:true, lock_spins:3374, lock_rate:0.08435, avg_lines_per_lock:1.082, lock_win:11263000} — a sane, populated mechanic section assembled from real data. ABORT checklist: (1) nopayid_win/win=0/7728=0.0 PASS; (2) no ST14/ST15 TopDollar (only ST13) PASS; (3) additive collect residual=0 PASS; (4) no IndexToWheelCellData/wheel-cell JSON PASS; (5) role confidently mapped to validated paid_spin precedent PASS.
caveats: Single-ST machine: ST=13 is the base paid spin (play 'Normal') with the LockReSpin feature carried IN-LINE on the same ST (ReMarks 'trigger' discriminator + LockLines token). There is NO separate hold_respin/respin ST; do NOT declare one. The lock-respin felt-experience is delivered by the shared parser's lock_lines accumulator -> machine_mechanics.lock_lines (verified populated), NOT by the M104 lock_respin_dynamics plugin (which is LockSymbols-only / play 'LockSymbolSpin' and would emit all-zeros if force-mapped to M133 — the exact mis-attribution failure this gate guards against).

CostCredits=0 on every record is a per-record echo, not free play. The real per-spin cost is the bet (1000), recovered from the LastCredits snapshot identity (LastCredits = 1e14 - 1000 + WinCredits, holds 40000/40000). Money is out of scope (charter), so this does not affect role mapping, but the manifest economy must use WinCredits as win_field.

Manifest should declare ST=13 as paid_spin/Normal with economy.win_field=WinCredits; NO synth_pay_id rule is needed (every win already has a conserving PayoutIdToWinAmount; no bare settlement). The lock mechanic needs NO special manifest block — the parser captures LockLines automatically and machine_mechanics renders it.

Audit was performed on mode_1 (the only mode with local cached rawdata). Modes 2/5/7 (skins) were not re-derived here; they are expected to share the ST=13 paid_spin/LockReSpin structure (skin = ReelSkin variant), but the onboarder/breaker should confirm modes 2/5/7 carry no additional ST before finalizing the multi-mode manifest.

No locally-cached rawdata exists for the other registered LockLines/LockReSpin precedents, so layer-(c) could not be run on a sibling machine; however the reuse target is the FROZEN shared parser path itself, which was verified directly against M133's own real data (3374 lock records, exact conservation).
